token.description: Secret reference only; the bot token must come from IPluginSecrets.

selfId.description: Discord bot user id used to build Source before login.

ignoreBots.description: Default true. Disabling lets bot messages enter NLMP; keep true unless another layer filters them.

ignoreSelf.description: Default true. Disabling can make the bot answer its own messages; orchestrator also ignores self by default.

reconnectWatchdog.description: Default true. Rebuild the gateway transport when connected stays false past the threshold.

reconnectWatchdogThresholdMs.description: Default 60000. Tolerated disconnected window before the watchdog rebuilds.

reconnectWatchdogTickMs.description: Default 0 (auto: threshold/4 clamped). Watchdog poll interval.

reconnectBackoffInitialMs.description: Default 1000. First retry delay after a failed rebuild.

reconnectBackoffMaxMs.description: Default 60000. Upper bound for the exponential backoff.

reconnectMaxAttempts.description: Default 10. After this many failed rebuilds the watchdog stops and flags manual intervention.

interactionCacheCapacity.description: Default 500. Bounded cache for interaction/channel lookups; older entries are evicted.

sendRetryMaxAttempts.description: Default 3. Attempts for a rate-limited (429) send before giving up.

sendRetryBaseDelayMs.description: Default 250. Base delay for send retries; honours retryAfter when Discord provides it.

sendRetryMaxDelayMs.description: Default 5000. Upper bound for a single send retry delay.
